### Day 71: 2 Samuel 20:14–22
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-71-2-samuel-20-1422.html
Passage: 2 Samuel 20:14-22
Points:
- Internal bickering creates vulnerabilities that opportunistic troublemakers like Sheba exploit to cause division.
- An unnamed wise woman refused to stay a passive bystander when destruction loomed over her community.
- She took initiative to negotiate with Joab and successfully persuaded the townspeople to remove the instigator of rebellion.
- Stepping forward with courage and wisdom can preserve an entire community from ruin, even without seeking recognition.
